text:
Priya Rao: Quick RFC follow-up: priv-sidecar quarantine -> run inference on Hosted/Dedicated safely. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/priv-evacuate
Devon Li: Quick question: do we ever copy customer keys to Hosted? sounds risky. Alternatives?
Samir Patel: Strong prefer ephemeral token-exchange. Control plane mints short-lived, HSM-signed exchange token scoped to inference; hosted redeems, no long-lived creds moved. TTL ~30-120s.
Anya Kuznetsova: Obs/security: tag traces with `quarantine=true` and `tenant_hash=sha256:8` prefix. Redact headers that may leak PII.
Priya Rao: Rollout sketch: tenant-level FF -> canary (10 tenants) -> 1% sweep -> full. Abort if error-rate >5% for 5m or p95 >1.5x.
Devon Li: Circuit-breaker: if exact model absent, serve compatible variant and set header `x-rdwd-fallback: 1`. Console must show which variant served.
Samir Patel: Billing/ops: tag requests `quarantine.tenant=<id>` for attribution and add billing alert. Audit event schema: `event_type, tenant_hash, actor, outcome, reason`. Encrypt at rest.
Priya Rao: Security hard constraint: NO copying/escrow of customer-managed keys. Use exchange pattern and HSM signing. All exchange actions must be auditable and obfuscated.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature/priv-evacuate staged -> build 10021 -> infra-canary -> https://ci.redwood/internal/10021
Devon Li: I'll pick up token-exchange endpoint and a small integration test.
Priya Rao: Thanks — owners set: Devon (token-exchange), Samir (audit & billing), Anya (tracing & e2e). I'll draft RFC follow-up with runbook and gating criteria.
